title: Position and direction words
examples: Teacher, where is the blue block compared to the red block?
Can you show me how to turn around?

explain.say: Look at the picture on the screen for us.
The ball is up high, above the box.
The box is down low, below the ball.
The toy car is right next to the teddy bear.
Point to your left hand now for me.

faq.q: What does 'above' mean when I look at a shelf?
faq.a: It means something is higher up than the shelf. For example, a picture hanging on the wall above the shelf.
asks: Where is the book above the chair?

faq.a: They are very similar, but 'below' just means lower down. If a cloud is below the sun, it is lower in the sky.
asks: Can you show me something below?

faq.q: If I say 'next to', does it mean touching?
faq.a: It means it is right beside something else. The two things do not have to touch to be next to each other.
asks: What is next to your shoe?

faq.q: How do I know my left from my right?
faq.a: You can hold up both hands and look at your body. Your left hand is on the left side when you face someone.
asks: Which hand is my left hand?
Can you check my left side?

faq.a: To turn means to change the way you are facing. You spin around to look in a different direction.

facts: Above means something is higher than another thing.
Below means something is lower than another thing.
Next to means something is beside something else.
We use left and right to talk about sides.
To turn means to change your direction or facing.

quiz.say: The bird flew high above the tree.
quiz.why: The bird is higher up than the tree, so above is the right word.

wrong.0: This is wrong because below means lower down, and the bird was high up.
wrong.1: This is wrong because next to means beside, not higher up.
wrong.2: This is wrong because under means directly beneath, not higher up.

quiz.say: The red crayon is next to the blue crayon.
quiz.why: Next to means right beside, which is what the picture shows.

wrong.1: This is wrong because above means higher up, not beside.
wrong.2: This is wrong because below means lower down, not beside.
wrong.3: This is wrong because left only talks about one side, not the position between two things.

quiz.say: If you face the board and then spin around, what did you do?
quiz.why: Turning means changing the way you are facing, like spinning around.

wrong.1: This is wrong because above describes height, not movement.
wrong.2: This is wrong because left only describes one side, not the action of spinning.
wrong.3: This is wrong because below describes a low position, not an action.
